themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI systems designed to autonomously perform research tasks and workflows with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and optimizing code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles detailing specific software and platforms designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Explores AI's capability to condense large amounts of text, such as meeting transcripts or research papers, into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Focuses on the use and impact of AI chatbots in various contexts, including mental health, companionship, and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is changing job roles, employment rates, and the skills required in the workforce.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Discusses how AI is being applied to enhance the design process, from user interface generation to design system management.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and rank different AI tools and platforms based on their features and performance.

themes.name: AI recruitment research
themes.description: Covers the use of AI in hiring processes, including talent acquisition, candidate screening, and job market analysis.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to gather, analyze, and derive actionable insights from customer data and behavior.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
